name: 1830 Calumet Avenue — Brick dwelling (district draft; refined by T-1946)

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '2B brick dwelling (D) with a rounded bay at the south corner of its Calumet front and a 2B rear part behind a dashed line; a one-storey and a two-storey frame closet (T.CL.) on its north side at the alley end'. research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3008, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 28x trace (s28xfp-calumet_1830-b1), the T-3008 census (s28x-1830-front) and the T-1837 register row frontage-28x-1830 (Brick dwelling); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3008).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3008 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. Rounded front bay at the south corner: a projecting bay on the Calumet front. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 3114135257 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
